# Third-party notices and licenses

This file summarizes third-party components ARCHMELD builds on. It is not a
substitute for the license texts shipped with each component.

## Upstream source: CodeGraph

- Repository: https://github.com/codegraph-ai/CodeGraph
- Pinned commit: `590c2ca7dd7b37bd1d41caf45fac535b6522f969`
- License: Apache-2.0
- `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are preserved at the repository root and were not
  modified.
- Local modifications are recorded in `UPSTREAM_PATCHES.md`.

## Upstream source: CodeBoarding (architecture candidates)

- Repository: https://github.com/CodeBoarding/CodeBoarding
- Pinned commit: `a38a8d157150e78cee4e4c0f3f0646a4ae9ed938` (also the checked-out
  HEAD when the real `analysis.json` was imported)
- License: MIT for the analysis engine / CLI; other distribution surfaces do not
  inherit that conclusion automatically and must be reviewed before use.
- It is consumed through its JSON `analysis.json` boundary; no Python runtime or
  source is bundled in the core or redistributed. The local checkout lives
  outside this repository and is never modified by ARCHMELD.

## Toolchain

Exact versions, executable paths, SHA-256 hashes and licenses for the local
build toolchain are recorded in `toolchains.lock.json` (generated by
`tooling/lock_toolchains.py`); language servers and JDKs are recorded in
`adapters/languages/tools.lock.json`. Notable components:

| Component | License |
|---|---|
| Rust / Cargo (pinned 1.94.1) | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| rust-analyzer (pinned with Rust 1.94.1) | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| LLVM libclang 18.1.1 (bindgen only) | Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception |
| clangd 18.1.8 | Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception |
| Pyright 1.1.408 | MIT |
| typescript-language-server 4.3.4 | Apache-2.0 |
| Eclipse Temurin JDK 25.0.5+8 (jdtls requirement) | GPL-2.0 WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 |
| Eclipse JDT Language Server 1.64.0 | EPL-2.0 |
| .NET SDK 8.0.427 | MIT (distribution includes its own third-party notices) |
| csharp-ls 0.14.0 | MIT |
| Go 1.27.3 | BSD-3-Clause |
| gopls 0.20.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| Git | GPL-2.0-only |
| MinGW-w64 GCC 13.2 | GPL-3.0-or-later (runtime exception applies to produced binaries) |
| Node.js | MIT |
| Python | PSF-2.0 |
| CMake | BSD-3-Clause |
| Ninja | Apache-2.0 |
| Perl | Artistic-1.0-Perl OR GPL-1.0-or-later |

## Rust crates

`third_party/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.generated.md` lists every resolved crate with
its declared SPDX license and repository. Regenerate with
`python tooling/gen_notices.py`; a crate without a declared license fails the
generator so it cannot be shipped silently.

## License review status

- Apache-2.0 is the default direction for ARCHMELD's own code.
- Upstream attribution, NOTICE files, third-party component licenses and model
  licenses must be reviewed separately before any distribution.
- This repository does not redistribute third-party source or binaries beyond
  the pinned upstream checkout and locally installed toolchains.
